description: For a workspace you created with signup and no human has claimed yet: creates another inbox (or identity) in the same workspace and returns its own API key, scoped to that inbox. Use this instead of calling signup again when the same person needs several agents: up to 3 before a human claims the workspace. Tell the user the api_key it returns (shown once).

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 time when the new key stops working (401 api_key_expired), at most about 5 years away. Leave it out for a key that never expires.

kind.description: mailbox (default): an inbox that sends and receives. identity: sign-in only, no mail.

name: add_agent
title: Add another agent to this workspace
